description: Fetch a page or API response (GET, or POST JSON) from a site that charges AI agents with HTTP 402 (x402), paid from AIPayGen credit you bought with a top-up: no wallet needed. Trial and referral credit pay only this $0.001 fee and free pages. You set max_price_usd and pay the site's price plus 15%, plus the fee. A site that takes the payment but doesn't return the page can't be refunded, so buy from sites you trust; if it never collects, your credit returns once the payment expires. Costs $0.001 per call, from an API key's prepaid credit (not payable with x402).

body.description: POST only: a JSON object or array (at most 16 KB), sent as application/json, byte for byte the same on the unpaid and the paid request.

max_price_usd.description: Most you'll pay the site for this page (default 0.05, at most 1). Our 15% fee is on top.

method.description: GET (default) or POST, for paid APIs that take input.

url.description: https URL of the page or API to buy, e.g. https://example.com/article

name: paid_fetch
title: Buy a page from an x402 site
